# S3.4a — the Stage-3 single-worker experiment engine (`hh-experiment`): `register`/`expand`/`open`/`next`/`claim`/`launch`/`settle`/`pause`/`resume`/`close`, the `measurement.experiment.*` event family, exactly-once settlement + KP-E1…E5 recovery, matched-budget enforcement at the four points, the Stage-3 exemplars, and the `registry_snapshot_id` catalog slice (R-2.10.3⁰ᵇ · R-2.10.2)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §6.3 (experiment engine) · §6.2
(registry/`slot_choices`/`param_schema`/`budget_relevant`)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/047_S3.4a__experiment-engine.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.10.3⁰ᵇ · R-2.10.2** (catalog slice)
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.3` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0278-s3.4a-experiment-engine-rulings.md`

## Summary

**Refusal-first, ledger-native.** `hh-experiment` lands the §6.3 engine:
`register` runs the closed E-1 refusal set over `SpecContext` resolvers
(`MissingMatchSpec`, `UnbudgetedArm`, `MissingPreRegistration`,
`InsufficientReplicates`, `InadmissibleFactor`, `SplitUnassigned`,
`UnsealedArtifact`, `DependsOnDriftedCapability`, `UnmatchedBudget`,
`IncommensurableMatch`, `MissingPricingTable`, …); `expand` produces a
content-addressed `RunPlan`/`CellPlan` doc with `n/a{level_ineligible}`
cells; `open_experiment` opens the `experiment` run kind and records
`declared` + one `run_planned` per plan in the deterministic order;
`next`/`claim`/`launch`/`settle`/`close` drive the single-worker loop
over `Store` + `LabDocs` with writer leases and fence-on-attach
recovery.

**Settlement is exactly-once and outcome-class-typed (§2.3).**
`run_settled` is idempotent over the immutable chain (re-settle replays
the recorded outcome); `infrastructure_failure` lands
`settled` → `excluded{infrastructure_retry}` → `replanned` in that order,
at `attempt_no + 1` under the same `seed_material`, bounded by
`ReattemptPolicy{max_per_plan, max_fraction_of_plans_ppm, backoff}`
(exceeding the fraction pauses `infrastructure_suspected`);
`oracle_failure` marks `regrade` — the subject is **never** re-run for a
grader fault (the overlay run is §06.5's machinery, S3.4b);
`cancelled{operator|hosting}` re-plans only under
`on_cancel = replan`; `cancelled{principal|parent}` is always final;
`budget_exhausted`/`context_exhausted`/`refused` are plan-final.
Superseded consumption reports as instrument waste, never evidence.

**Matched budgets are enforced at all four points.** E-1 `register`:
the per-dimension `budget_enforcement` view (a `matched_cap` dimension
not `enforced` on every arm ⇒ `IncommensurableMatch`, CF-350) and the
AC-R-2.10.2-12 coverage check (a `budget_relevant` parameter differing
across arms must have every `affects` dimension in each arm's
`MatchSpec`, else `UnmatchedBudget`). E-2 `launch`: the arm's
`eval_budget` is the root; an unfundable slice refuses replannable
(`InsufficientBudget`), never trims a run. E-3 `settle`/`close`: per-run
`budget_utilization` ppm records; `MatchSpec.utilization_floor` arms the
`under_utilised` annotation — an under-utilising arm is never cheaper
(ADR-0041 M1). E-4 `close`: `budget_match` re-checks comparand groups
over realised runs at the declared tolerance
(`matched | imbalanced`), insufficient-replicate cells render
`n/a{not_run}`, and `provider_drift` is a stratum flag.

**The order is task-blocked and arm-interleaved.** `interleaved` /
`interleaved_blocked` order keys are `(block, task_rank : replicate :
arm_rank)` derived under the `experiment.order.task`/`experiment.order.arm`
domains from the recorded `permutation_seed` — reproducible from the
seed alone (S-6; ADR-0184 D2).

**Exemplars run end-to-end.** `lab/compaction-family-v1` (2 arms × 3
tasks × 5 replicates = 30 plans) and `lab/control-strategy-family-v1`
(5 arms incl. the `iso_cost` companion — ADR-0213's duplicate-run
control for OQ-363 — × 2 tasks × 5 replicates = 50 plans) execute
`open`→`close` to `completed`. `registry_snapshot_id` flows
`Design` → `ExperimentSpec` → `declared` payload → subject
`RunManifest`'s `ExperimentBinding`.

**The registry is never model-facing.** `C-LCD-5`
(`RegistryOperationBound`) refuses a `ToolCapability` bound to a
registry operation at `validate_assembly` stage 7 — both HIR node
`source` records and inline assembly entities (AC-R-2.10.2-6;
ADR-0151 R6).

**The boundary is records-in/records-out** (ADR-0277 precedent):
`lab.experiment.*` ops carry the resolver material as params
(`budgets`, `suite_tasks`, `arm_configs`, `ineligible_levels`,
`fingerprints`, `drifted_capabilities`, `sealed_artifacts`,
`budget_enforcement`, `budget_relevant_params`, `min_replicates`,
`retirement_diff`); absent resolvers defer, never guess.

## Evidence highlights

- `hh-experiment` 29 engine tests — lifecycle, refusal corpus,
  exactly-once settle, KP-E1…E5, pause gating, both exemplars at
  Stage-3 size, plus the review battery: oracle-failure never re-runs,
  principal/parent cancel is final, task-blocked ordering,
  under-utilisation + `budget_match` re-check at close, `n/a{not_run}`
  partial close, settled→excluded→replanned order.
- `hh-lab` — `budget_relevant`-coverage and enforcement refusals at
  register (AC-R-2.10.2-12, CF-350).
- `hh-eval` — `compare_refuses_cross_mode_match` (CF-334).
- `hh-assembly` — `registry_operation_bound_as_tool_capability_refuses`
  (`C-LCD-5`, stage 7).

## Deferrals / deviations

- OQ-363 stays OPEN under ADR-0213 — the `iso_cost` companion arm
  duplicates subject runs rather than sharing them across MatchSpecs
  (AC-R-2.10.3-9's sharing half is conditionally deferred).
- The regrade overlay run is §06.5's machinery — `run_settled{regrade}`
  is the durable marker (S3.4b consumes it).
- `lab.analysis.*`/`lab.results.*` store-backed services stay S3.4b–c.
- Progress notes appended to DF-S1.24-1 / DF-S1.24-2; no rows closed.
- **Resumed-run note:** continued an interrupted worker's tree
  (`bd90368` + `0afa453`); kept on merit — the continuation fixed the
  oracle-failure/cancel settlement semantics, the interleaved order
  keys, the E-3/E-4 close records, the E-1 enforcement/`budget_relevant`
  checks, `C-LCD-5`, and added the regression battery.
